releasePlan.notes: Roles: enable-backend-status-error-rate = killswitch; enable-backend-status-latency = pause (two-armed — the page handler reports its render duration on control and v1 alike); enable-backend-status-success-rate = monitoring (one-armed — only the v1 page beacons an outcome, so control produces no comparison). The frontend has no OTel or LaunchDarkly observability SDK, so track() is the only valid backing and span_coverage is none; no observability package was installed. sentry-errors-binary / sentry-errors-count were considered and rejected as global guardrails: only the Flask backend initializes Sentry, so this frontend service can never emit them.
